### DELETE /machine-identities/v1/{id}/delete-async

`deleteMachineIdentityAsyncV1` — Delete AI agent asynchronously — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API deletes an AI agent machine identity. It applies only to AI agents. Application machine identities return `400`; delete them with the delete machine identity API instead. When the AI agent was aggregated from a source and still exists on that source, the API starts a deletion task on the source and returns the task status. When the AI agent was created manually or no longer exists on the source, the API deletes it immediately and returns `200` with an empty body. The API returns `400`…

- Scopes: idn:dataset:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Machine Identity ID.
- Returns 200: taskstatus

### GET /machine-identities/v1/anomaly-summaries/unsanctioned

`getUnsanctionedAnomalySummaryV1` — Get unsanctioned application anomaly summary — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns aggregate counts (distinct agents, distinct owners, and total events) for anomalies of type **unsanctioned_app** across the tenant. Powers the Unsanctioned Agents card on the Agent Registry page.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: unsanctionedsummary

### GET /machine-identities/v1/all-counts

`getMachineIdentityAllCountsV1` — Get owner machine identity counts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the number of application machine identities, AI agent machine identities, and machine accounts owned by one identity, plus their total. Identify the owner with an `ownerId` filter. Use `ownerId eq "me"` for the caller's own counts. Requests without an `ownerId` filter return `400`. A caller who owns the machine identities and machine accounts can view their own counts. Other callers need the **idn:mis-identity:read** or **idn:mis-account:read** right.

- Scopes: idn:mis-account:read, idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query, required) — fields: ownerId: eq — e.g. `ownerId eq "me"`
- Returns 200: machineidentityallcounts

### GET /machine-identities/v1/agent-counts

`getMachineIdentityAgentCountsV1` — Get AI agent counts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns tenant-wide summary counts for AI agent machine identities: the total, unsanctioned agents, agents discovered in the last 30 days, risk severity counts, and ownership coverage. When agentic risk scoring is not enabled for the tenant, `riskSeverity` is `null`. This version never counts AI agents that have no risk severity, so `riskSeverity.unknown` is always `null`.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: machineidentityagentcounts

### GET /machine-identities/v1/application-counts

`getMachineIdentityApplicationCountsV1` — Get application counts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns tenant-wide summary counts for application machine identities: the total, unsanctioned applications, applications discovered in the last 30 days, risk severity counts, and ownership coverage. When agentic risk scoring is not enabled for the tenant, `riskSeverity` is `null`. This version never counts applications that have no risk severity, so `riskSeverity.unknown` is always `null`.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: machineidentityapplicationcounts

### GET /machine-identities/v1/counts/daily

`getMachineIdentityDailyCountsV1` — Get daily non-human entity counts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns daily counts of machine identities, machine accounts, capabilities, and credentials for the tenant. The window ends on the day before the current UTC date and covers the number of days set by `days`. The response contains one entry per day. Days with no recorded counts have an empty `metrics` array.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `days` (query) — max 90 — default 30 — Number of days in the window. Values outside 1 to 90 return `400`.
  - `entityType` (query) — one of machine_identity, machine_account, capability, credential — Return counts for this entity type only. Other values return `400`.
  - `subType` (query) — Return counts for this subtype only. The value must exactly match a recorded subtype.
- Returns 200: machineidentitydailycounts

### GET /machine-identities/v2/hostnames

`listMachineIdentityHostnamesV2` — List AI agent hostnames — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the distinct hostnames of AI agent machine identities, in ascending order. Hostnames are returned in lowercase with accents removed. The API pages with a cursor instead of an offset. To get the next page, pass the last hostname of the current page as `cursor`. A page with fewer hostnames than `limit` is the last page. A caller who owns AI agents can list the hostnames of those agents. Other callers need the **idn:mis-identity:read** right.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `prefix` (query) — Return only hostnames that start with this value. Matching ignores case and accents. A blank value is ignored.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 50 — Maximum number of hostnames to return. Values of `0` or more than `250` return `400`.
  - `cursor` (query) — Return only hostnames that sort after this value. Pass the last hostname of the previous page. Omit it for the first page. A blank value returns `400`.
- Returns 200: array of string

### POST /machine-identities/v2/bulk-update

`updateMachineIdentitiesInBulkV2` — Bulk update machine identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API applies the same JSON Patch operations to up to 100 machine identities and returns a result for each requested ID. Only `/description`, `/userEntitlements`, `/owners`, `/owners/primary`, and `/owners/secondary` can be patched. Patching any other path returns `400`. When access requests for non-human identities are not enabled for the tenant, a patch that changes `/userEntitlements` returns `403`. The response is always `207` when the request is valid. Check the `status` of each result…

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): machineidentitybulkupdaterequest

### POST /machine-identities/v2/bulk-delete

`deleteMachineIdentitiesInBulkV2` — Bulk delete machine identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API deletes up to 100 machine identities and returns a result for each requested ID. The response is always `207` when the request is valid. Check the `status` of each result to see whether that machine identity was deleted. A caller who owns a machine identity can delete it. Other callers need the **idn:mis-identity:delete** right. For callers without that right, IDs of machine identities they do not own return a `404` result.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): machineidentitybulkrequest

### POST /machine-identities/v1/lifecycle-actions/{requestId}/cancel

`cancelMachineIdentityLifecycleActionV1` — Cancel machine identity lifecycle action — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Cancels a lifecycle action request that hasn't started provisioning yet. When the cancel is accepted, the request moves to `CANCELING` status. A request can't be canceled once provisioning has started, after it has finished, or while a cancel is already in progress. The request body is optional.
